## 1. Overview & Experimental Architecture

This document executes and analyzes computational experiments using the **`Segregation Experiments.nlogox`** agent-based model. Both households (`families`) and third places (`venues`) are generated at **model setup (Tick 0)** under the `"parametric-setup"` regime, with utility weights ($\beta_1$ for residential neighbors, $\beta_2$ for venue co-patrons) active from Tick 0.

### 1.1 Venue Type Spectrum via $\text{Beta}(\alpha, \beta)$
Each of the `venues-number` venues draws a spectrum score $x \sim \text{Beta}(\alpha, \beta) \in [0, 1]$ using NetLogo's gamma generators:

- **Red Venues ($0 \le x < 1/3$)**: Group-specific to Red (`color = red`, `my-venue-exclusivity = venue-exclusivity`).
- **Non-Exclusive Venues ($1/3 \le x \le 2/3$)**: Universal third places open to all households regardless of color or adventurousness (`color = gray`, `my-venue-exclusivity = 0`).
- **Blue Venues ($2/3 < x \le 1$)**: Group-specific to Blue (`color = blue`, `my-venue-exclusivity = venue-exclusivity`).

### 1.2 Type-Specific Spatial Placement Parameters
Each venue type $t \in \{\text{red}, \text{blue}, \text{neutral}\}$ is placed on the map at `setup` according to four spatial parameters:

1. **Centrality ($C_t \in [0, 1]$)**: Radial position of cluster anchors from the map borders ($0.0$) to the city center ($1.0$).
2. **Regularity / Jitter ($J_t \in [0, 1]$)**: Deterministic geometric ring/lattice ($0.0$, no jitter) vs. maximum angular and radial perturbation ($1.0$, max jitter).
3. **Number of Clusters ($k_t \in \{1, \dots, 20\}$)**: Number of spatial cluster anchors for venue type $t$.
4. **Closeness ($S_t \in [0, 1]$)**: Intra-cluster proximity between venues, from widely dispersed ($0.0$) to tightly packed around each cluster anchor ($1.0$).

```{r setup}
if (!requireNamespace("sensobol", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("sensobol", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
library(tidyverse)
library(logolink)
library(sensobol)
library(patchwork)
library(colorspace)
library(ggnewscale)
library(janitor)

# Absolute path to the NetLogo model and Sobol' design matrix file
model_path <- normalizePath(
  "roads/Segregation Experiments.nlogox",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
sobol_design_path <- file.path(dirname(model_path), "sobol_design.txt")

# Helper to serialize a 17-column Sobol' design matrix to NetLogo list-of-lists format
write_sobol_design_file <- function(design_df, path = sobol_design_path) {
  req_cols <- c(
    "pre_beta1", "pre_beta2", "exclusivity", "beta_alpha", "beta_beta",
    "red_c", "red_j", "red_k", "red_s",
    "blue_c", "blue_j", "blue_k", "blue_s",
    "neutral_c", "neutral_j", "neutral_k", "neutral_s"
  )
  stopifnot(all(req_cols %in% colnames(design_df)))
  mat <- as.matrix(design_df[, req_cols])
  row_strings <- apply(mat, 1, function(r) {
    paste0("[", paste(format(round(r, 5), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), collapse = " "), "]")
  })
  nl_content <- paste0("[\n  ", paste(row_strings, collapse = "\n  "), "\n]\n")
  writeLines(nl_content, con = path)
  invisible(path)
}

# Helper to construct parameter lists with symmetric or type-specific placement
make_venue_constants <- function(
  sobol_row = 0,
  beta1 = 0.50,
  beta2 = 0.50,
  venue_beta_alpha = 1.0,
  venue_beta_beta = 1.0,
  venue_exclusivity = 1.0,
  venues_number = 18,
  centrality = 0.5,
  jitter = 0.0,
  clusters_k = 2,
  closeness = 0.5,
  red_centrality = centrality,
  red_jitter = jitter,
  red_clusters_k = clusters_k,
  red_closeness = closeness,
  blue_centrality = centrality,
  blue_jitter = jitter,
  blue_clusters_k = clusters_k,
  blue_closeness = closeness,
  neutral_centrality = centrality,
  neutral_jitter = jitter,
  neutral_clusters_k = clusters_k,
  neutral_closeness = closeness
) {
  list(
    "sobol-row"                 = sobol_row,
    "density-percent"           = 70,
    "number-of-ethnicities"     = 2,
    "proportion-majority"       = 60,
    "neighborhood-distance"     = 5,
    "venues-number"             = venues_number,
    "venue-catchment-distance"  = 7,
    "venue-exclusivity"         = venue_exclusivity,
    "proportion-of-integration" = 100,
    "intervention-scenario"     = "parametric-setup",
    "relocation-fraction"       = 0.10,
    "utility-noise-sd"          = 0.10,
    "clustering-sample-size"    = 150,
    "pre-beta1-neighbors"       = beta1,
    "pre-beta2-venue-group"     = beta2,
    "post-beta1-neighbors"      = beta1,
    "post-beta2-venue-group"    = beta2,
    "beta3-venue-loc"           = 0,
    "beta4-home-venues"         = 0,
    "beta5-park-group"          = 0,
    "beta6-roads-group"         = 0,
    "venue-beta-alpha"          = venue_beta_alpha,
    "venue-beta-beta"           = venue_beta_beta,
    "red-centrality"            = red_centrality,
    "red-jitter"                = red_jitter,
    "red-clusters-k"            = red_clusters_k,
    "red-closeness"             = red_closeness,
    "blue-centrality"           = blue_centrality,
    "blue-jitter"               = blue_jitter,
    "blue-clusters-k"           = blue_clusters_k,
    "blue-closeness"            = blue_closeness,
    "neutral-centrality"        = neutral_centrality,
    "neutral-jitter"            = neutral_jitter,
    "neutral-clusters-k"        = neutral_clusters_k,
    "neutral-closeness"         = neutral_closeness,
    "travel-distance"           = 5,
    "road-multiplier"           = 1,
    "road-scenario"             = "empty",
    "road-density"              = 0,
    "road-connectiveness"       = 0,
    "parks-number"              = 0,
    "random-seed?"              = FALSE
  )
}
```

### 1.3 Quick Model & Sobol' Dispatch Smoke Test

```{r smoke-test}
# Verify compilation, setup-time venue placement, Beta spectrum counts, and Sobol' row dispatch
smoke_sobol_df <- tibble(
  pre_beta1   = c(0.60, 0.30),
  pre_beta2   = c(0.40, 0.70),
  exclusivity = c(1.00, 0.50),
  beta_alpha  = c(0.50, 3.00),
  beta_beta   = c(0.50, 3.00),
  red_c       = c(0.10, 0.90),
  red_j       = c(0.00, 0.20),
  red_k       = c(3,    1),
  red_s       = c(0.80, 0.90),
  blue_c      = c(0.10, 0.90),
  blue_j      = c(0.00, 0.20),
  blue_k      = c(3,    1),
  blue_s      = c(0.80, 0.90),
  neutral_c   = c(0.90, 0.20),
  neutral_j   = c(0.00, 0.20),
  neutral_k   = c(1,    3),
  neutral_s   = c(0.90, 0.80)
)
write_sobol_design_file(smoke_sobol_df)

smoke_setup <- create_experiment(
  name = "Model_Sobol_Smoke_Test",
  repetitions = 1,
  run_metrics_every_step = FALSE,
  setup = "setup",
  go = "go",
  time_limit = 5,
  metrics = c(
    "count-red-venues",
    "count-neutral-venues",

smoke_res <- model_path |>

smoke_res[["table"]] |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(
    sobol_row,
    step,
    count_red_venues,
    count_neutral_venues,
    count_blue_venues,
    mean_venue_dist_center,
    index_dissimilarity,
    index_exposure
  )
```

## 2. Experiment 1: Spatial Placement Design Space (Centrality $\times$ Closeness $\times$ Regularity)

In this experiment, venues and households are initialized at Tick 0 under an equal utility trade-off ($\beta_1 = 0.50, \beta_2 = 0.50$) and a uniform venue spectrum ($\text{Beta}(1, 1)$). We sweep across:

- **Centrality**: `0.0` (Pushed to Borders), `0.5` (Mid-Ring), `1.0` (Central)
- **Clustering Closeness** (with $k = 3$ clusters per type): `0.1` (Dispersed) vs. `0.9` (Tightly Clustered)
- **Regularity (Jitter)**: `0.0` (Regular / Deterministic) vs. `1.0` (Max Random Jitter)

### 2.1 Factorial Design Grid & Execution

```{r exp1-grid}
exp1_scenarios <- crossing(
  centrality = c(0.0, 0.5, 1.0),
  closeness  = c(0.1, 0.9),
  jitter     = c(0.0, 1.0)
) |>
  mutate(
    centrality_label = factor(
      case_when(
        centrality == 0.0 ~ "Border (C = 0.0)",
        centrality == 0.5 ~ "Mid-Ring (C = 0.5)",
        centrality == 1.0 ~ "Central (C = 1.0)"
      ),
      levels = c("Border (C = 0.0)", "Mid-Ring (C = 0.5)", "Central (C = 1.0)")
    ),
    closeness_label = factor(
      ifelse(closeness >= 0.5, "Tight Clusters (S = 0.9)", "Dispersed (S = 0.1)"),
      levels = c("Dispersed (S = 0.1)", "Tight Clusters (S = 0.9)")
    ),
    jitter_label = factor(
      ifelse(jitter == 0.0, "Regular (J = 0.0)", "Random Jitter (J = 1.0)"),
      levels = c("Regular (J = 0.0)", "Random Jitter (J = 1.0)")
    ),
    batch_id = row_number()
  )
```

```{r exp1-execution}
results_exp1 <- exp1_scenarios |>
  pmap(function(centrality, closeness, jitter, centrality_label, closeness_label, jitter_label, batch_id) {
    run_constants <- make_venue_constants(
      sobol_row = 0,
      beta1 = 0.50,
      beta2 = 0.50,
      venue_beta_alpha = 1.0,
      venue_beta_beta = 1.0,
      centrality = centrality,
      jitter = jitter,
      clusters_k = 3,
      closeness = closeness
    )

    setup_file <- create_experiment(
      name = paste0("Venue_Topology_Batch_", batch_id),
      repetitions = 5,
      run_metrics_every_step = TRUE,
      setup = "setup",
      go = "go",
      time_limit = 600,
      metrics = c(
        "index-exposure",
        "index-dissimilarity",
        "index-clustering",
        "index-concentration",
        "index-centrality",
        "mean-venue-dist-center"
      ),
      constants = run_constants
    )

    raw_output <- model_path |>
      run_experiment(setup_file = setup_file, output = "table")

    raw_output[["table"]] |>
      clean_names() |>
      mutate(
        centrality_label = centrality_label,
        closeness_label = closeness_label,
        jitter_label = jitter_label
      )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()
```

### 2.2 Trajectory & Terminal Segregation Plots

```{r exp1-plots, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
traj_exp1 <- results_exp1 |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("index_"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric = str_to_title(str_remove(metric, "index_")),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Dissimilarity", "Clustering", "Exposure", "Concentration", "Centrality"))
  ) |>
  filter(metric %in% c("Dissimilarity", "Clustering", "Exposure", "Concentration")) |>
  group_by(step, metric, centrality_label, closeness_label, jitter_label) |>
  summarize(
    median_val = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_exp1_traj <- ggplot(
  traj_exp1,
  aes(x = step, color = centrality_label, fill = centrality_label, linetype = jitter_label)
) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.14, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median_val), linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ closeness_label, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.85, name = "Venue Centrality") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.85, name = "Venue Centrality") +
  labs(
    title = "Segregation Trajectories Across Venue Centrality, Closeness, and Regularity",
    subtitle = "Setup-time initialization (Ticks 0–600) | k = 3 clusters per venue type | β1 = 0.5, β2 = 0.5",
    x = "Simulation Tick",
    y = "Index Value",
    linetype = "Placement Regularity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_exp1_traj)

ggsave(
  "1-experiments_venue_spatial_topology.png",
  p_exp1_traj,
  width = 10,
  height = 7.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## 3. Experiment 2: Beta Venue Type Spectrum & Asymmetric Placement by Venue Type

Here we test how the **composition of the venue type spectrum**—governed by $\text{Beta}(\alpha, \beta)$—interacts with **differential placement parameters across venue types** (`red`, `blue`, `non-exclusive`).

### 3.1 Beta Distribution Regimes & Placement Strategies

```{r exp2-design, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.5}
beta_regimes <- tibble(
  alpha = c(0.25, 1.0, 5.0, 1.5),
  beta  = c(0.25, 1.0, 5.0, 4.5),
  spectrum_label = factor(
    c(
      "Polarized Exclusive (α=0.25, β=0.25)",
      "Uniform Spectrum (α=1.0, β=1.0)",
      "Non-Exclusive Dominant (α=5.0, β=5.0)",
      "Red-Skewed Spectrum (α=1.5, β=4.5)"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "Polarized Exclusive (α=0.25, β=0.25)",
      "Uniform Spectrum (α=1.0, β=1.0)",
      "Non-Exclusive Dominant (α=5.0, β=5.0)",
      "Red-Skewed Spectrum (α=1.5, β=4.5)"
    )
  )
)

# Visualize the theoretical Beta(alpha, beta) spectrum regimes and type cutoffs (1/3, 2/3)
x_grid <- seq(0.005, 0.995, length.out = 400)
beta_curves <- beta_regimes |>
  rowwise() |>
  reframe(
    spectrum_label = spectrum_label,
    x = x_grid,
    density = dbeta(x_grid, alpha, beta)
  )

ggplot(beta_curves, aes(x = x, y = density, color = spectrum_label)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1/3, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = "#e41a1c", alpha = 0.08) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1/3, xmax = 2/3, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = "gray50", alpha = 0.12) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2/3, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = "#377eb8", alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1/3, 2/3), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  facet_wrap(~ spectrum_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "mako", end = 0.85, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Beta(α, β) Venue Type Spectrum Regimes",
    subtitle = "Left third [0, 1/3): Red Venues | Middle [1/3, 2/3]: Non-Exclusive Venues | Right (2/3, 1]: Blue Venues",
    x = "Spectrum Draw (x)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

We cross these Beta regimes with three **Type-Specific Placement Strategies**:

1. **Central Neutral / Border Exclusive**: Non-exclusive venues clustered at the city center (`neutral-centrality = 1.0, k = 1, closeness = 0.9`), while Red and Blue exclusive venues are placed near the borders (`red/blue-centrality = 0.0, k = 3, closeness = 0.8`).
2. **Border Neutral / Central Exclusive**: Non-exclusive venues pushed to the borders (`neutral-centrality = 0.0, k = 3`), while Red and Blue venues occupy the city center (`red/blue-centrality = 1.0, k = 1, closeness = 0.8`).
3. **Symmetric Mid-Ring**: All three venue types share identical mid-ring clustered parameters (`centrality = 0.5, k = 3, closeness = 0.8, jitter = 0.2`).

```{r exp2-execution}
placement_strategies <- tibble(
  strategy_label = factor(
    c(
      "Central Neutral / Border Exclusive",
      "Border Neutral / Central Exclusive",
      "Symmetric Mid-Ring"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "Central Neutral / Border Exclusive",
      "Border Neutral / Central Exclusive",
      "Symmetric Mid-Ring"
    )
  ),
  red_c     = c(0.0, 1.0, 0.5),
  red_k     = c(3,   1,   3),
  red_s     = c(0.8, 0.8, 0.8),
  blue_c    = c(0.0, 1.0, 0.5),
  blue_k    = c(3,   1,   3),
  blue_s    = c(0.8, 0.8, 0.8),
  neutral_c = c(1.0, 0.0, 0.5),
  neutral_k = c(1,   3,   3),
  neutral_s = c(0.9, 0.8, 0.8)
)

exp2_scenarios <- crossing(beta_regimes, placement_strategies) |>
  mutate(batch_id = row_number())

results_exp2 <- exp2_scenarios |>
  pmap(function(
    alpha, beta, spectrum_label,
    strategy_label, red_c, red_k, red_s, blue_c, blue_k, blue_s, neutral_c, neutral_k, neutral_s,
    batch_id
  ) {
    run_constants <- make_venue_constants(
      sobol_row = 0,
      beta1 = 0.40,
      beta2 = 0.60,
      venue_beta_alpha = alpha,
      venue_beta_beta = beta,
      jitter = 0.15,
      red_centrality = red_c,
      red_clusters_k = red_k,
      red_closeness = red_s,
      blue_centrality = blue_c,
      blue_clusters_k = blue_k,
      blue_closeness = blue_s,
      neutral_centrality = neutral_c,
      neutral_clusters_k = neutral_k,
      neutral_closeness = neutral_s
    )

    setup_file <- create_experiment(
      name = paste0("Beta_Spectrum_Batch_", batch_id),
      repetitions = 5,
      run_metrics_every_step = TRUE,
      setup = "setup",
      go = "go",
      time_limit = 600,
      metrics = c(
        "index-exposure",
        "index-dissimilarity",
        "index-clustering",
        "index-concentration",
        "count-red-venues",
        "count-neutral-venues",
        "count-blue-venues"
      ),
      constants = run_constants
    )

    raw_output <- model_path |>
      run_experiment(setup_file = setup_file, output = "table")

    raw_output[["table"]] |>
      clean_names() |>
      mutate(
        spectrum_label = spectrum_label,
        strategy_label = strategy_label
      )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

save(results_exp1, results_exp2, exp1_scenarios, exp2_scenarios, file = "results_venue_placement_experiments.RData")
```

## 4. Variance-Based Global Sensitivity Analysis (`sensobol`)

To decompose the variance of residential segregation outcomes into main effects and higher-order interactions, we compute **first-order ($S_i$)** and **total-order ($T_i$) Sobol' sensitivity indices** using Saltelli's quasi-random design (`type = "QRN"`) in `sensobol`:

$$
S_i = \frac{V_{X_i}\!\left(E_{\mathbf{X}_{\sim i}}[Y \mid X_i]\right)}{V(Y)}, \qquad
T_i = \frac{E_{\mathbf{X}_{\sim i}}\!\left[V_{X_i}(Y \mid \mathbf{X}_{\sim i})\right]}{V(Y)}
$$

where $T_i - S_i$ measures the variance attributable to **nonlinear and interactive couplings** between parameter $i$ and all other parameters.

### 4.1 Experiment 3A: Global Venue Placement, Spectrum & Utility Sensitivity ($k = 8$)

We first evaluate $k = 8$ core mechanisms simultaneously across the global venue design space:

1. `centrality` ($C \in [0, 1]$): Radial venue placement from city borders ($0$) to center ($1$).
2. `jitter` ($J \in [0, 1]$): Spatial regularity ($0 = $ regular ring/lattice, $1 = $ maximum random jitter).
3. `clusters_k` ($k \in \{1, \dots, 8\}$): Number of spatial cluster anchors per venue type.
4. `closeness` ($S \in [0, 1]$): Intra-cluster tightness around cluster anchors.
5. `beta_alpha` ($\alpha \in [0.2, 5.0]$): $\text{Beta}(\alpha, \beta)$ shape parameter $\alpha$.
6. `beta_beta` ($\beta \in [0.2, 5.0]$): $\text{Beta}(\alpha, \beta)$ shape parameter $\beta$.
7. `exclusivity` ($E \in [0, 1]$): Group exclusivity of Red and Blue venues.
8. `venue_weight` ($\beta_2 \in [0.1, 0.9]$, with $\beta_1 = 1 - \beta_2$): Household utility weight placed on venue co-patron similarity vs. residential neighbor similarity.

```{r sobol-exp3a-design}
params_3a <- c(
  "centrality",
  "jitter",
  "clusters_k",
  "closeness",
  "beta_alpha",
  "beta_beta",
  "exclusivity",
  "venue_weight"
)

N_3a <- 64
mat_3a_unit <- sobol_matrices(
  N = N_3a,
  params = params_3a,
  order = "first",
  type = "QRN"
)

# Scale unit hypercube [0, 1] columns to physical model parameter intervals
mat_3a_scaled <- as_tibble(mat_3a_unit) |>
  mutate(
    centrality   = centrality,
    jitter       = jitter,
    clusters_k   = pmin(8, pmax(1, floor(1 + clusters_k * 8))),
    closeness    = closeness,
    beta_alpha   = 0.2 + beta_alpha * (5.0 - 0.2),
    beta_beta    = 0.2 + beta_beta * (5.0 - 0.2),
    exclusivity  = exclusivity,
    venue_weight = 0.1 + venue_weight * (0.9 - 0.1)
  )

# Expand to the 17-column NetLogo sobol_design.txt table
sobol_df_3a <- mat_3a_scaled |>
  transmute(
    pre_beta1   = 1.0 - venue_weight,
    pre_beta2   = venue_weight,
    exclusivity = exclusivity,
    beta_alpha  = beta_alpha,
    beta_beta   = beta_beta,
    red_c       = centrality,
    red_j       = jitter,
    red_k       = clusters_k,
    red_s       = closeness,
    blue_c      = centrality,
    blue_j      = jitter,
    blue_k      = clusters_k,
    blue_s      = closeness,
    neutral_c   = centrality,
    neutral_j   = jitter,
    neutral_k   = clusters_k,
    neutral_s   = closeness
  )

write_sobol_design_file(sobol_df_3a)
cat("Experiment 3A Sobol' rows:", nrow(sobol_df_3a), "(N =", N_3a, ", k =", length(params_3a), ")\n")
```

```{r sobol-exp3a-run}
setup_3a <- create_experiment(
  name = "Sobol_Exp3A_Global_Venue_Sensitivity",
  repetitions = 3,
  run_metrics_every_step = FALSE,
  setup = "setup",
  go = "go",
  time_limit = 250,
  metrics = c(
    "index-dissimilarity",
    "index-clustering",
    "index-exposure",
    "index-concentration",
    "index-centrality",
    "mean-venue-dist-center"
  ),
  constants = make_venue_constants(sobol_row = seq_len(nrow(sobol_df_3a)))
)

raw_3a <- model_path |>
  run_experiment(setup_file = setup_3a, output = "table")

agg_3a <- raw_3a[["table"]] |>
  clean_names() |>
  group_by(sobol_row) |>
  summarize(
    Dissimilarity = mean(index_dissimilarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Clustering    = mean(index_clustering, na.rm = TRUE),
    Exposure      = mean(index_exposure, na.rm = TRUE),
    Concentration = mean(index_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    Centrality    = mean(index_centrality, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(sobol_row)
```

```{r sobol-exp3a-indices, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
metrics_to_analyze <- c("Dissimilarity", "Clustering", "Exposure", "Concentration", "Centrality")

sobol_results_3a <- map(metrics_to_analyze, function(m_name) {
  y_vec <- agg_3a[[m_name]]
  ind <- sobol_indices(
    Y = y_vec,
    N = N_3a,
    params = params_3a,
    boot = TRUE,
    R = 1000,
    type = "jansen",
    first = "saltelli"
  )
  dum <- sobol_dummy(
    Y = y_vec,
    N = N_3a,
    params = params_3a,
    boot = TRUE,
    R = 1000
  )
  list(metric = m_name, indices = ind, dummy = dum)
}) |>
  set_names(metrics_to_analyze)

# Diagnostic plots for Dissimilarity (uncertainty distribution + scatter across all 8 inputs)
p_unc_3a <- plot_uncertainty(Y = agg_3a$Dissimilarity, N = N_3a) +
  labs(title = "Output Uncertainty Distribution (Dissimilarity)", x = "Dissimilarity Index")

p_scat_3a <- plot_scatter(
  data = as.matrix(mat_3a_scaled),
  N = N_3a,
  Y = agg_3a$Dissimilarity,
  params = params_3a,
  method = "bin"
) +
  labs(title = "Marginal Response Surfaces Across 8 Sobol' Parameters (Dissimilarity)")

print(p_unc_3a)
print(p_scat_3a)

# Combine Si and Ti indices across all 5 Massey & Denton dimensions
indices_table_3a <- map(sobol_results_3a, function(res) {
  as_tibble(res$indices$results) |>
    mutate(metric = res$metric)
}) |>
  list_rbind()

dummy_table_3a <- map(sobol_results_3a, function(res) {
  as_tibble(res$dummy) |>
    mutate(metric = res$metric)
}) |>
  list_rbind()

param_labels_3a <- c(
  centrality   = "Venue Centrality (C)",
  jitter       = "Placement Jitter (J)",
  clusters_k   = "Cluster Count (k)",
  closeness    = "Cluster Closeness (S)",
  beta_alpha   = "Beta Spectrum α",
  beta_beta    = "Beta Spectrum β",
  exclusivity  = "Venue Exclusivity (E)",
  venue_weight = "Venue Utility Weight (β2)"
)

p_sobol_3a <- indices_table_3a |>
  filter(sensitivity %in% c("Si", "Ti")) |>
  mutate(
    param_clean = factor(param_labels_3a[parameters], levels = rev(unname(param_labels_3a))),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = metrics_to_analyze),
    Order = ifelse(sensitivity == "Si", "First-Order (Si)", "Total-Order (Ti)")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = param_clean, y = original, fill = Order, color = Order)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = low.ci, ymax = high.ci),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = dummy_table_3a |>
      filter(sensitivity %in% c("Si", "Ti")) |>
      mutate(
        metric = factor(metric, levels = metrics_to_analyze),
        Order = ifelse(sensitivity == "Si", "First-Order (Si)", "Total-Order (Ti)")
      ),
    aes(yintercept = high.ci, color = Order),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", begin = 0.15, end = 0.75) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", begin = 0.15, end = 0.75) +
  labs(
    title = "Variance-Based Sobol' Sensitivity Indices Across Massey & Denton Dimensions",
    subtitle = "First-order (Si) vs. Total-order (Ti) effects with 95% bootstrap CIs and dummy thresholds (dashed)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Sobol' Sensitivity Index (Proportion of Variance)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_sobol_3a)

ggsave(
  "3a-sobol_global_venue_sensitivity.png",
  p_sobol_3a,
  width = 11,
  height = 7.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

### 4.2 Experiment 3B: Type-Specific Asymmetric Venue Placement Sensitivity ($k = 14$)

To test whether spatial placement of **Non-Exclusive** universal venues or **Red/Blue** group-exclusive venues exerts stronger leverage over residential sorting, we run a second Sobol' experiment varying all **12 type-specific placement parameters** alongside the **2 Beta spectrum shape parameters** ($k = 14$, holding $\beta_1 = 0.4, \beta_2 = 0.6$, and `venue-exclusivity = 1.0`):

- **Red Venues**: `red_c`, `red_j`, `red_k`, `red_s`
- **Blue Venues**: `blue_c`, `blue_j`, `blue_k`, `blue_s`
- **Non-Exclusive Venues**: `neutral_c`, `neutral_j`, `neutral_k`, `neutral_s`
- **Venue Type Spectrum**: `beta_alpha`, `beta_beta`

```{r sobol-exp3b-design}
params_3b <- c(
  "red_c", "red_j", "red_k", "red_s",
  "blue_c", "blue_j", "blue_k", "blue_s",
  "neutral_c", "neutral_j", "neutral_k", "neutral_s",
  "beta_alpha", "beta_beta"
)

N_3b <- 64
mat_3b_unit <- sobol_matrices(
  N = N_3b,
  params = params_3b,
  order = "first",
  type = "QRN"
)

sobol_df_3b <- as_tibble(mat_3b_unit) |>
  transmute(
    pre_beta1   = 0.40,
    pre_beta2   = 0.60,
    exclusivity = 1.00,
    beta_alpha  = 0.2 + beta_alpha * (5.0 - 0.2),
    beta_beta   = 0.2 + beta_beta * (5.0 - 0.2),
    red_c       = red_c,
    red_j       = red_j,
    red_k       = pmin(8, pmax(1, floor(1 + red_k * 8))),
    red_s       = red_s,
    blue_c      = blue_c,
    blue_j      = blue_j,
    blue_k      = pmin(8, pmax(1, floor(1 + blue_k * 8))),
    blue_s      = blue_s,
    neutral_c   = neutral_c,
    neutral_j   = neutral_j,
    neutral_k   = pmin(8, pmax(1, floor(1 + neutral_k * 8))),
    neutral_s   = neutral_s
  )

write_sobol_design_file(sobol_df_3b)
cat("Experiment 3B Sobol' rows:", nrow(sobol_df_3b), "(N =", N_3b, ", k =", length(params_3b), ")\n")
```

```{r sobol-exp3b-run}
setup_3b <- create_experiment(
  name = "Sobol_Exp3B_TypeSpecific_Placement_Sensitivity",
  repetitions = 3,
  run_metrics_every_step = FALSE,
  setup = "setup",
  go = "go",
  time_limit = 250,
  metrics = c(
    "index-dissimilarity",
    "index-clustering",
    "index-exposure",
    "index-concentration",
    "index-centrality"
  ),
  constants = make_venue_constants(
    sobol_row = seq_len(nrow(sobol_df_3b)),
    beta1 = 0.40,
    beta2 = 0.60,
    venue_exclusivity = 1.0
  )
)

raw_3b <- model_path |>
  run_experiment(setup_file = setup_3b, output = "table")

agg_3b <- raw_3b[["table"]] |>
  clean_names() |>
  group_by(sobol_row) |>
  summarize(
    Dissimilarity = mean(index_dissimilarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Clustering    = mean(index_clustering, na.rm = TRUE),
    Exposure      = mean(index_exposure, na.rm = TRUE),
    Concentration = mean(index_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    Centrality    = mean(index_centrality, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(sobol_row)
```

```{r sobol-exp3b-indices, fig.width=11, fig.height=8.5}
sobol_results_3b <- map(metrics_to_analyze, function(m_name) {
  y_vec <- agg_3b[[m_name]]
  ind <- sobol_indices(
    Y = y_vec,
    N = N_3b,
    params = params_3b,
    boot = TRUE,
    R = 1000,
    type = "jansen",
    first = "saltelli"
  )
  dum <- sobol_dummy(
    Y = y_vec,
    N = N_3b,
    params = params_3b,
    boot = TRUE,
    R = 1000
  )
  list(metric = m_name, indices = ind, dummy = dum)
}) |>
  set_names(metrics_to_analyze)

indices_table_3b <- map(sobol_results_3b, function(res) {
  as_tibble(res$indices$results) |>
    mutate(metric = res$metric)
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(
    venue_group = case_when(
      str_starts(parameters, "red_")     ~ "Red Exclusive Venues",
      str_starts(parameters, "blue_")    ~ "Blue Exclusive Venues",
      str_starts(parameters, "neutral_") ~ "Non-Exclusive Venues",
      TRUE                               ~ "Beta Type Spectrum"
    )
  )

p_sobol_3b <- indices_table_3b |>
  filter(sensitivity == "Ti", metric %in% c("Dissimilarity", "Clustering", "Exposure", "Centrality")) |>
  mutate(
    parameters = factor(parameters, levels = rev(params_3b)),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Dissimilarity", "Clustering", "Exposure", "Centrality"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = parameters, y = original, fill = venue_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = low.ci, ymax = high.ci), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Red Exclusive Venues"  = "#e41a1c",
      "Blue Exclusive Venues" = "#377eb8",
      "Non-Exclusive Venues"  = "#636363",
      "Beta Type Spectrum"    = "#984ea3"
    ),
    name = "Parameter Group"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Type-Specific Total-Order Sobol' Sensitivity Indices (Ti) by Venue Category",
    subtitle = "Comparing Red, Blue, and Non-Exclusive spatial placement parameters (C, J, k, S) and Beta(α, β)",
    x = "Parameter",
    y = "Total-Order Sobol' Index (Ti)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_sobol_3b)

ggsave(
  "3b-sobol_typespecific_venue_sensitivity.png",
  p_sobol_3b,
  width = 10.5,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

save(
  mat_3a_scaled, agg_3a, sobol_results_3a, indices_table_3a,
  sobol_df_3b, agg_3b, sobol_results_3b, indices_table_3b,
  file = "results_sobol_venue_sensitivity.RData"
)
```
